definitions.explanation: Communication or contact from a person, especially letters or messages that indicate someone is alive and well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{音信|おんしん}{不通|ふつう}になった。
examples.english: I lost all contact with him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧{音信|おんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: A letter arrived from a friend I hadn't heard from in a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}して→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{音信|おんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{途絶|とだ}えて→途絶える：14317_todaeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: After moving overseas, all communication was cut off.

notes:
Most commonly encountered in the set expression {音信|おんしん}{不通|ふつう} (losing all contact with someone). The word itself means news or communication from a person, but it is used almost exclusively in negative or loss-of-contact contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音信|おんしん}{不通|ふつう}: loss of contact; no word from someone
- {音信|おんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{途絶|とだ}える→途絶える：14317_todaeru⟧: for communication to be cut off
- {音信|おんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no word/contact

USAGE:
Also read as いんしん in some contexts, though おんしん is the standard modern reading. The expression {音信|おんしん}{不通|ふつう} is by far the most common usage — learners should prioritize this four-character compound.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧: contact/communication — the everyday word for staying in touch
- ⟦{便|たよ}り→便り：03411_tayori⟧: news/letter from someone — similar meaning but more literary
